scenarios.title: A｜预约
scenarios.setting: 玩家需要提前预约时间到办事大厅办理业务。

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d like to make an appointment to submit my application.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to make an appointment to submit my application.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: I’d like to book an appointment for next week.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to book an appointment for next week.
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: Do I need an appointment to come in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need an appointment to come in?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: I’d like to speak with someone about my application. Can I make an appointment?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to speak with someone about my application. Can I make an appointment?
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: I want to reserve a time to do my application.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to make an appointment to submit my application.
feedback.explanation: 预约办理用“make / book an appointment”；“reserve a time to do my application”显得绕。

turns.text: Sure. What day works best for you?

turns.prompt: 你想说明适合自己的预约日期，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have anything available on Monday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available on Monday?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Tuesday morning would be best for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Tuesday morning would be best for me.
feedback.explanation: “would be best”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Anytime after two would work.

feedback.naturalExpression: Anytime after two would work.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: What’s the earliest appointment you have available?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the earliest appointment you have available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

turns.text: We have an opening at 10:30 on Tuesday.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: 10:30 works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: 10:30 works for me.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Great. I’ll take that one.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll take that one.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Perfect. Could you book me in for 10:30?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Could you book me in for 10:30?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.text: You’re all set. Please arrive ten minutes early.

turns.prompt: 你想确认预约后需要准备的材料或确认信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do I need to bring anything with me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to bring anything with me?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Great. Will I receive a confirmation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Will I receive a confirmation?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll be here ten minutes early.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll be here ten minutes early.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜预约失败
scenarios.setting: 玩家想预约，但近期已经没有空位。

turns.text: I’d like to make an appointment for this week.
I’m sorry, but we’re fully booked this week.

turns.prompt: 你想询问最早可以办理的预约时段，会怎么说？

choices.text: What’s the earliest appointment available?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the earliest appointment available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Do you have anything available next week?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything available next week?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Are there any cancellations I could take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any cancellations I could take?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Is there another location with earlier appointments?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another location with earlier appointments?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: You don’t have any free time this week?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the earliest appointment available?
feedback.explanation: 机构的预约时段常说“availability / openings”；“free time”更像工作人员个人的空闲时间。

turns.text: The earliest appointment we have is next Thursday.

turns.prompt: 你想在等待较久的情况下了解其他办理选择，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s quite a long wait. Is there any other option?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s quite a long wait. Is there any other option?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Can I complete the process online instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I complete the process online instead?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Could I come in without an appointment?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I come in without an appointment?
feedback.explanation: “appointment”指预约，强调事先安排的时间。

choices.text: Could you let me know if an earlier appointment becomes available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you let me know if an earlier appointment becomes available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

turns.text: You can check the booking system again later. Cancellations sometimes become available.

turns.prompt: 关于「预约与进度」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll check again later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll check again later.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: In that case, I’ll book next Thursday for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, I’ll book next Thursday for now.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

scenarios.title: C｜询问办理时间 / 进度
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经提交申请一段时间，但一直没有收到结果。

turns.text: Hi. I’m calling to check the status of my application.
Sure. When did you submit it?

turns.prompt: 关于「预约与进度」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I submitted it about three weeks ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I submitted it about three weeks ago.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I applied online on August 15.

feedback.naturalExpression: I applied online on August 15.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: It’s been almost a month, and I haven’t received an update yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s been almost a month, and I haven’t received an update yet.
feedback.explanation: “I haven’t received”表示到现在仍未收到，适合查询邮件、物品或办理结果。

choices.text: I was told it would take about two weeks.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was told it would take about two weeks.
feedback.explanation: “was told”表示这是此前被告知的信息；交代来源，有助于核对不同说法。

choices.text: I want to know where my application is now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I submitted it about three weeks ago.
feedback.explanation: 查申请进度用“check the status of my application”；不必把申请描述成在某个地点。

turns.text: Do you have your application reference number?

turns.prompt: 关于「预约与进度」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes. It’s A47291.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It’s A47291.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes. Let me find it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Let me find it.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: I don’t have it with me. Can you look it up using my name?

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t have it with me. Can you look it up using my name?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

turns.text: Your application is still being processed.

turns.prompt: 你想了解还需要多少时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know how much longer it might take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much longer it might take?
feedback.explanation: “How much longer”问还要多久，关注从现在起剩余的等待时间。

choices.text: Is there anything else you need from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else you need from me?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Has there been any problem with my application?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has there been any problem with my application?
feedback.explanation: “application”指申请或申请材料，办理时可据此查询进度。

choices.text: Will I be notified when a decision has been made?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I be notified when a decision has been made?
feedback.explanation: “has been”把过去开始的状态与现在联系起来，常用于说明持续情况或经历。

turns.text: You should receive an update within the next week.

turns.prompt: 关于「预约与进度」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll wait for the update.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll wait for the update.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll check again if I don’t hear anything next week.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll check again if I don’t hear anything next week.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
